**Axes:** count accuracy, required-argv binding, read-only integrity.

One read-only Python fact command completed successfully (exit **0**) on `.ufo/evidence/round-21/coldread/ledger.json`.

| Measurement | Result |
|---|---:|
| Entries | **249** |
| Sum of `commands_executed_count` | **1,941** |
| Entries with positive integer counts | **249/249** |
| Missing, zero, negative or noninteger counts | **0** |
| Count range | **1–64** |
| Entries explicitly binding required argv | **0/249** |
| Trace-path references | **1,904** |

**Finding:** Every entry records a positive command count, but none contains an explicit required-command/argv receipt binding. Entries retain source hashes, `read_rev`, and trace references; these do **not**, by themselves, establish execution of the required registry commands. Referenced trace contents were not inspected.

**Retained evidence:** Full command and per-entry output are in this transcript. Ledger SHA-256:
`2488bee81ddd16a2e5fc05c10caff282c93f1c113f913cccb0eed65fdc59d08c`

**Files changed:** None, including no report file, per the wave’s no-write restriction. No tests, builds, formatters, installations, or Git mutations. No blockers.
